name: OpenGL 3D
summary: A full 3D renderer for GameBasiX (OpenGL on Windows, software in HTML5).
description: Renders 3D scenes and copies the finished frame into the normal GameBasiX screen. Windows uses a hidden OpenGL 1.1 context; the HTML5 player uses a built-in software rasterizer with the same commands. It provides perspective and orthographic projections, a push/pop transform stack, directional lighting, boxes, cubes, spheres, cylinders and cones, quads, grids, lines, triangles and points, plus depth test, back-face culling, alpha blending, line width and point size. Sprites loaded with SPRITE_LOAD, SPRITE_GRAB or ANIM_LOAD can be bound as textures for quads and cubes. The first run compiles the INLINE block with g++.
author: GameBasiX
